# Support

- Questions, bugs and suggestions: open an [issue](https://github.com/Joako601/market-backend/issues/new/choose).
- Security problems: follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Do not open a public issue.

Before opening an issue, check that PostgreSQL is running and that `application-dev.properties` exists. Most startup errors come from a missing database or a wrong password.

This is a personal project. Answers are best effort.
